node.title: KoalaBear near-negative literal-assignment coverage
node.closure: all 48 literal near-negative assignment/root cells are excluded componentwise
node.statement: The aligned-negative literal identities show that every monic reconstructed negative q-slice residual has constant term one. A near target Omega={xi,d} therefore forces (xi d)^2=1. The plus branch is a reciprocal J_0/J_1 label collision. On the minus branch d=-1/xi, and c+d=0 would also be a label collision, so one generic reconstruction minor covers every admissible point. Directly compile the twelve literal source-star assignments and four literal xi roots. Their 48 cells contain 64 genuine consistency components after determinant units are removed. On every component the complete q-slice coefficient ideal is unit on the named open under both one-step Rabinowitsch localization and independent sequential saturation over characteristic 2130706433. Hence the near-negative literal residual is empty.
